intended_organization_or_user: Nonprofit organizations seeking to improve fundraising
major_ideas: Nonprofit founders often lack skills to grow their organizations effectively.
Four key fundraising skills can help nonprofits transition from stagnant to thriving.
Building donor psychology, nonprofit marketing, and financial literacy are essential for growth.
prerequisites: Willingness to learn and implement new skills
proposed_workflow: Identify and learn the four key fundraising skills: donor psychology, marketing, financial literacy, and strategic planning.
Implement these skills in the recommended order to streamline the learning process.
Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of these skills in leading to increased fundraising success.
title: The 4 Skills That Raise More Money for Your Nonprofit
